text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Condemnation of Turkish invasion of northern Iraq continues.
- Turkish invasion is a flagrant challenge to Arab nation.
- Jordanian union calls for the resumption of flights between Baghdad and Amman.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz receives head of a French aid organisation.
- Spain ready for economic cooperation with Iraq.
(The above were also carried by THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Editorial on delays in implementing oil-for-food deal.
- Article on investment and national development.
- Commentary attacks Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
- Police capture gang accused of theft and murder in the southern province of Missan.
